# Pmc fixtures

Article-version JSON, metadata-only entries and S3 inventory manifest/gzip CSV shards.

Adapted from the MIT-licensed [open-arrow-access v0.1.0 service tests](https://github.com/dentiny/open-arrow-access/tree/v0.1.0/service/tests) and its `pmc` fixture data. Local payloads are reduced/synthetic adaptations.
